findings.description: A durable epoch/completed snapshot can exist after a crash before curve.json update. Recovery can produce the final receipt without reconstructing curve.json from state.curve, leaving an incomplete exported learning curve.
findings.required_change: Regenerate curve.json from the checked durable snapshot on recovery and before final/recovered receipt. Add synthetic recovery test with absent/stale curve.json; no training is required.
findings.resolution: Durable-state recovery regenerates curve.json before recovering a final receipt, and finalization regenerates it before the completed snapshot. Synthetic completed-state fixture checks exact recovered curve without optimizer steps.
